builds.name: Beautiful Blade
builds.desc:
With great 33/36 offenses, Summer Camilla can wreak havoc through the use of a -Blade+ tome and flier buffs.
Weapon: Blárblade+ is the centerpiece of the build, amping up Camilla's damage output significantly after receiving flier buffs.
Assist: Reposition is an all-around useful assist skill and suits Camilla better than most other options.
Special: Glimmer is the go-to special option for units with innately high damage output.
A Passive: Fury 3 is one part of the tried-and-true Fury/Desperation combo---boosting her base stats while also chipping her into range of Desperation.
B Passive: Desperation 3 is a crucial part to the builds of glass cannons like Summer Camilla, allowing her to successively strike twice before the opposing unit may counterattack once below the relevant threshold.
C Passive: Hone Fliers or Goad Fliers are likely the ideal choices for Camilla and depend on team composition (do note, however, that Hone Fliers will ideally be wanted on another unit to provide buffs for Camilla's blade tome).
Sacred Seal: Flier Formation 3 is the suggested seal for Summer Camilla, increasing the effective area she can threaten, but a variety of other seal choices work as well---Speed +3 seal being another worthwhile choice.
As with all player-phase nukes, dancers (for this build, flying dancers) are a simple but effective way to up Summer Camilla's potential. Additionally, pairing this Camilla build with a straightforward way of dealing with high-res Greens is wise---notable partners being Elincia, Caeda, and NY Camilla, as they synergize well offensively while supplying more flier buffs.

builds.name: Tropical Punch Camilla
builds.desc:
This build focuses on Camilla's decent attack and speed stats to wreak havoc among the enemy.
Weapon Juicy Wave+ is Summer Camilla's standard weapon so all that needs to be done is give it the speed refine for that nice little boost. With it's built in Desperation it doubles most enemies.
Assist: Draw Back is a neat trick for moving around units. Of course Reposition can also be used but having a mixture of reposition and draw back within a team can make some interesting moving tactics.
Special: Astra is used here to help take out more difficult opponents. Of course it does have a cooldown speed of 4 but with Camilla's knack for doubling most enemies it can be used pretty early if Camilla is used correctly.
A Passive: Swift Sparrow 2 gives a further atk and spd boost for Camilla. Alternatively Death Blow can be used as it is the standard A slot passive for her.
B Passive: Brash Assault 3 This passive is more insurance for doubling enemies as her weapon comes with Desperation built in, making it a hard time to defeat her even on low HP.
C Passive: Flexible.
Sacred Seal: Quickened Pulse brings Astra down to a cooldown of 3, making it available to use sooner at the start of a run, also shortening its cooldown frequently during Tempest Trials & Chain Challenges.
